cases.title: #240 Pale Lacquer & Raden Decorative Illustration
cases.imageAlt: Hand Drawn Style 240 Pale Lacquer & Raden Decorative Illustration
cases.prompt:
Hand-drawn style #240 · Pale Lacquer & Raden Decorative Illustration (original reference: plain lacquer mother-of-pearl illustration style).
Core style characteristics: **Contemporary new Chinese style two-dimensional decorative illustrations of light-colored lacquer paintings, integrating the modeling language of classical Chinese figure paintings and modern graphic design. The whole is first presented as a flat decorative painting rather than a traditional meticulous realistic painting. The shape is highly summarized, with complete and smooth outlines. The proportions and shapes of the characters are adaptive according to the theme, but always remain simplified, slender, and subtle. The face has almost no real volume, the facial features are concise, symbolic, and whitened, and the skin color is even and smooth. ** **The body is shaped with clear outlines, large-area flat color blocks, and a very small amount of soft transitions. Internal details are obviously deleted and patterned; weak light and dark, weak perspective, and weak spatial depth do not represent real light sources, and do not use aerial perspective and realistic depth of field. ** **Adopt high-brightness, light-warm tones as a whole, but avoid excessive graying, powdering and fading of colors. Approximately 65%–80% of the picture is maintained in bright areas such as ivory white, off-white, light apricot, warm gray, and light jade; traditional mineral colors such as cinnabar, azurite, stone green, gray blue, and light ocher are used as limited medium-area color blocks. The overall saturation is slightly increased by about 10%-15% based on the original light elegance, making the cinnabar fresher, the azurite clearer, and the azurite more clear, but it still remains soft and restrained, and does not enter a state of high saturation, richness, or gaudiness. ** **The color relationship emphasizes the contrast of "light base + a small amount of pure color blocks": large-area backgrounds and skin colors continue to maintain low saturation and high brightness. The edges of clothing, utensils, flowers and leaves, and local decorations can use slightly purer cinnabar red, azurite blue, and stone green to form a visual rhythm. Avoid brightening the entire painting evenly, and avoid increasing the saturation of all colors at the same time. ** **Dark colors only bear a small amount of outline, structure and visual anchor points. It is forbidden to form large areas of black or dark brown blocks. Avoid black paint base, dark gold base and heavy palace tones. The area of ​​dark colors should be significantly smaller than light colors and neutral colors, and the overall area should still remain transparent, bright, and soft. ** **The surface retains the warmth, delicacy and slightly mineral feel of traditional Chinese lacquer art, but is dominated by light-colored paint, matte paint and soft mineral pigment textures. The color surface can have a slight graininess of mineral pigments, natural color difference and warm thickness, but it does not pursue heavy black paint, accumulation of gold foil, high reflection or jewel-like luster. ** ** Mother-of-pearl and mother-of-pearl are only used as a very small amount of "decorative mosaic layer", not as global materials. The iridescent area is controlled to about 3%–8% of the picture, and only appears in local patterns, edges, embellishment areas or secondary surfaces with clear decorative properties; it must not randomly cover the main shape, nor change the original material properties of the subject. ** **The effect of mother-of-pearl should be flaky, finely divided, localized, and restrained in the color cast of caladium. It can have very slight green, pink, purple, or light blue iridescence, but the comprehensive color must obey the overall mineral color system, rather than forming a large flash, crystallization, metallization, or jewelry effect. ** **Especially keep the core shape of the subject, skin, face, main large color blocks and large-area background materials pure, and not be invaded by mother-of-pearl textures. The iridescence is only a visual accent, not the main texture of the picture. ** **The picture emphasizes decorative composition, establishing layers through plane overlay, outline occlusion, local transgression and shape interspersion; the space is closer to the organizational logic of lacquer paintings, murals, screen paintings and modern decorative paintings, rather than the perspective of real scenes. ** **The overall temperament is bright, warm, quiet, quaint, delicate, light and subtle. Compared with the traditional low-saturation new Chinese illustrations, the colors are slightly more vivid, clearer, and have the purity of mineral pigments, but they still maintain high-end, restraint, and oriental aesthetics, and do not make rich national trends or bright commercial illustrations. ** **Avoid: large areas of black, black paint base, dark gold tones, heavy palace feel, global mother-of-pearl, random iridescent coverage, large shell collage, crystallization, jewelery, excessive gray powder, excessive cream color, full screen fading, low contrast to white, rich national trend, highly saturated contrasting colors, fluorescent colors, realistic fine brushwork, realistic human body shaping, modern antique style CG, photography, cinematic light and shadow, real three-dimensional space, realistic landscape perspective, complex clothing patterns, fine embroidery, high-density environmental details, and fairy tale atmosphere. **

The raw model independently completes the before and after comparison of "real photographic presentation × translation of the same subject's artistic style":

[Real photography area (default top in horizontal version / left side in vertical version)]:
The raw image model generates ultra-realistic, high-quality SLR photography real photos based on the theme (if the user uploads a reference image, it shall prevail). Strictly maintain the original aspect ratio and compositional integrity of the original image, and stretching, deformation or cropping is strictly prohibited. Maintain the true depth of field, natural light, real skin/hair texture and on-site capture atmosphere of the photography, without redrawing it in an illustrative manner, as a real photography benchmark before style translation.

[Art translation area (default below in horizontal version / right side in vertical version) - Complete translation of realistic and univocal compositions]:
1. Completely derealize and redraw the painting style from scratch (resolutely put an end to photo filters):
The artistic translation side must form an impactful cross-media contrast with the photography side! Resolutely do not apply filters or materials directly to the realistic facial features and light and shadow volume of the original photo. cases.title: IG-031 Encyclopedia Information Card
cases.imageAlt: Typesetting graphics IG-031 Encyclopedia style information card
cases.prompt:
Little Red Book infographic. Layout: Encyclopedia style information card. It adopts a three-section structure of "top main specimen display area + middle asymmetric multi-module information area + bottom data source area". The top part is centered on the main visual object/specimen, with title, scientific name/subtitle, classification label and a small amount of basic information. The middle part organizes 6-10 information modules through a thin line grid, coordinate system and golden section, mixing subtitles, short articles, diagrams, comparisons, data bars, maps, timelines and other forms. The overall graphics and text are mixed, orderly and sufficient with sufficient white space. A weakened numbering, annotation or source explanation area is set up at the bottom to present a rational design that combines herbarium archives with modern museum navigation boards.

Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: Encyclopedic information card. Structured in three tiers: "top primary specimen display zone + middle asymmetrical multi-module information zone + bottom source reference zone". The top is centered around a primary visual object/specimen, accompanied by the main title, scientific name/subtitle, classification tags, and concise foundational details. The middle section organizes 6–10 information modules through hairline grids, coordinate systems, and golden-ratio compositions, integrating subheadings, short paragraphs, diagrams, comparative charts, data bars, maps, and timelines into a well-ordered, generous typographic balance. The bottom contains an understated numbering, footnote, or reference citation area, presenting a rational design aesthetic combining herbarium archival sheets with contemporary museum exhibition boards.

cases.title: IG-032 Hand-drawn editable knowledge infographic
cases.imageAlt: Typesetting graphics IG-032 hand-drawn editable knowledge infographic
cases.prompt:
Little Red Book infographic. Layout: hand-drawn editorial knowledge infographic. It adopts the composition of "super large title at the top + large core main visual in the middle + multiple knowledge point modules with numbered numbers around it + summary area at the bottom". The core main visual is obviously larger than other elements and serves as the visual center of the whole picture. It is naturally surrounded by 4-8 knowledge point modules. Each module has a clear and eye-catching numerical sequence (such as 01, 02, 03, 04) to create a sense of list and reading flow. Each numbered module contains a short title, a brief description, and a small visual explanation (such as a small scene illustration, icon, comparison, process, thought bubble, or mini-comic). The modules are flexibly arranged around the core vision, not in a rigid regular grid, allowing arrows, labels, speech bubbles and handwritten notes to be interspersed and connected. Set up a one-sentence summary, keyword extraction, or checklist area at the bottom to wrap up the entire image. The overall presentation is a vivid hand-drawn texture that combines magazine editorial illustrations, knowledge information graphics and light comic narratives. The characters are highly summarized, the composition is simple, and there is a lot of white space.

Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: Hand-drawn editorial knowledge infographic. Structured as "top oversized headline + central prominent hero visual + surrounding numbered knowledge modules + bottom summary section". The central hero visual is substantially larger than other elements, serving as the dominant visual focal point. 4 to 8 knowledge modules surround the core illustration naturally, each bearing a prominent numbered badge (such as 01, 02, 03, 04) to establish a clear reading sequence and list structure. Each numbered module contains a concise title, brief explanation, and miniature visual breakdown (such as mini-scene illustrations, icons, comparisons, process flows, thought bubbles, or mini comic panels). Modules flow organically around the core visual rather than adhering to a rigid grid, connected flexibly by arrows, tags, speech bubbles, and handwritten notes. The bottom features a concluding one-line takeaway, keywords, or checklist. The overall composition merges magazine editorial illustration, knowledge infographic diagramming, and light comic narrative into a lively hand-drawn aesthetic. Keep characters highly simplified, use a concise composition, and preserve generous negative space.

cases.title: IG-033 Lecture-style high-density analysis infographic
cases.imageAlt: Layout graphic IG-033 Lecture-style high-density analysis infographic
cases.prompt:
Little Red Book infographic. Layout: Lecture-style high-density analysis infographic. One page of handout-style analysis and layout with high information density presents a clear structure of "first overview, then decomposition, and then summary". The main title bar and core points/quick overview area are set up at the top; the middle is the main analysis area, which is composed of multiple numbered independent analysis card modules. Each module contains subtitles of key points, bullet lists, formula boxes and local illustrations, and is interspersed with table containers, step process areas and mind maps/process connection areas. Rich visual rhythm is formed through content areas of different sizes; the bottom is set up with a general column key conclusion area and an error-prone reminder/pitfall explanation area, supplemented by an edge supplementary explanation area and a small corner annotation box. The layout follows a strict reading order from top to bottom and left to right, with clear partitions and clear container borders. There is no poster-style layout with a single visual center, no mechanically divided grid, and no purely decorative image elements other than knowledge points.

Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: High-density handout analytical infographic. A single-page, high-density structured study handout layout following a clear "overview, breakdown, and summary" visual hierarchy. The top features a prominent main header bar paired with a core key takeaways/overview panel. The middle section serves as the core analytical body, composed of multiple sequentially numbered modular cards featuring subheadings, bullet points, formula containers, and localized diagrammatic explanations, flexibly interspersed with structured table containers, step-by-step procedure sequences, and flowchart/decision-tree connection zones to create an engaging visual rhythm across varied block sizes. The bottom anchors the page with full-width key conclusion and warning/error-alert callout sections, complemented by marginal annotations and compact corner callout boxes. The layout follows a strict top-to-bottom, left-to-right reading order with distinct container boundaries and structured card frames; avoids single-focal-point poster composition, avoids rigid equal grids, and strictly excludes decorative imagery outside essential informational diagrams.
